title: Fly brain pick-and-place above 90% after PPO
note: Frozen complete MaleCNS, three test episodes the imitation controller failed. Left: imitation only (384 demonstrations, one DAgger round), which lifts but does not place. Right: after PPO on the linear output map alone, all three placed. Over the 48 held-out test episodes the validation-selected controller places 46 (95.8%), against 35 (72.9%) before PPO; seeds 0 and 1 reach 97.9% and 91.7%.

title: Fly brain pick-and-place, imitation only
note: Frozen complete MaleCNS, only the linear input and output maps trained: 384 demonstrations, one DAgger round chosen on validation success. 35 of 48 held-out test episodes placed (72.9%). This clip shows the first six test episodes: 3 placed, 3 not. PPO on the output map then reaches 46/48.

title: Fly brain spins a cube with a four-finger hand
note: LEAP hand, four fly legs as fingers, complete MaleCNS frozen. Seed 0 on 64 test episodes: 62 successes, 2 drops, 38 rad mean rotation (teacher 64, 0, 49.7). With the connectome's edges off: 0 of 64. Controls on the same seed: a degree-preserving shuffle 63 of 64 at 35 rad, a parameter-matched GRU 64 of 64 at 50 rad. The connectome can do it; it is not better.

title: RL on the fly brain: cubes heavier than any it trained on
note: Cube mass 6 to 10x, never seen in training. Left, imitation only: grasps but cannot lift (3 of 3). Right, after PPO tuned only the motor decoder with the connectome frozen: placed 3 of 3. Control: PPO through a shuffled connectome also learns to lift, but places fewer heavy cubes late in training (6 vs 15 of 24 on average); one run each.

title: RL on the fly brain: the standard pick-and-place task
note: Same seeds before and after PPO: 1 placed and 2 only grasped before, 1 placed and 2 lifted after. Over 24 test episodes PPO raised lifting from 18 to 24; placing did not improve reliably.

title: Complete MaleCNS picks and places a cube (imitation, seed 2)
note: 166,700 frozen neurons between 1,846 ascending inputs and 2,022 descending and motor outputs.

title: The same training on a shuffled connectome (seed 2)
note: Degree-preserving shuffle of the same CNS, identical data and budget.

title: Kitchen protocol v2: fly CNS, shuffled CNS, MLP, GRU and ACT on one episode
note: The Franka as the fly's left front leg; the fly controller opens the microwave.

title: Kitchen: the fly leg opens the slide cabinet, and every lesion removes it
note: Proprioception-only interface, seed 2: intact, leg deafferented, edges off, direct synapses only.

title: RL on the fly brain: randomized cube mass and grip friction
note: Training distribution (mass 1 to 4x, friction 0.15 to 1x). On these three seeds PPO lifts every cube but places none; over 24 test episodes placement doubled (5 to 10).
